tools.name: menu
tools.description: Return the full menu for all announced venues. Each item carries sku, name, prices_by_order_method, available, and allergens.

venue_slug.description: Optional: filter to a single venue slug. Omit to receive all venues.

tools.name: order
tools.description: Build a basket for the venue's own ordering rail. Checkout and payment happen on the venue's own page; this tool does not place or settle the order.

items.description: Basket lines. Identify each item by `sku` or by the venue's `id` — exactly one. A sku matching more than one item (pizza: 36, 110, 44) is refused; pass `id` there.

sku.description: Venue sku. Refused when it identifies more than one item — use `id` instead.

id.description: The venue's own item id, unique where a sku is not.

fulfilment.description: How the order will be fulfilled.
